in_sanskrit.name: क्षमा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The ability to forgive and bear with the mistakes and shortcomings of others. The quality of being tolerant and patient. Kshama is derived from the Sanskrit root word 'ksham' meaning 'to bear, to tolerate, to forgive'. It is also the name of a goddess in Hindu mythology, often depicted as the embodiment of forgiveness and compassion.

in_hindi.name: क्षमा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The term 'कहांतक' in Hindi can be translated to 'forgiver', which is synonymous with the meaning of the name Kshama. It is a name that signifies the quality of being patient and tolerant, and the ability to forgive.

in_tamil.name: கஷ்மம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil word 'கஷ்மம்' can be translated to 'forgiver' or 'compassionate one'. It is a name that signifies the quality of being patient and tolerant, and the ability to forgive. In Tamil culture, the term 'கீழ்வார்' is used to refer to someone who is kind, compassionate, and forgiving.

in_telugu.name: క్ష్మమ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu word 'క్ష్మమ' can be translated to 'forgiver' or 'compassionate one'. It is a name that signifies the quality of being patient and tolerant, and the ability to forgive. In Telugu culture, the term 'గోపదేశ్య' is used to refer to someone who is kind, compassionate, and forgiving.

in_marathi.name: Kshama
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kshama हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The ability to forgive and forget, showing patience and understanding towards others.
